profile.headline: Software Engineer at Vivint Smart Home
profile.summary: Former Wildland Firefighter. I am passionate about creating mobile responsive, cross-browser compatible web applications .  The computer science field excites me because I will always have an opportunity to learn new tech and build cool things.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I originally recreated the classic memory game as a static site. After playing around with Aframe web-based VR I thought it would be fun to remake my original game for Oculus Rift. There are still a few things I'm working out on Simon VR but you can visit the beta site, and play either with mouse and keyboard or Oculus Rift! Make sure you are using a web-based VR browser such as Firefox. 

Github repo: https://github.com/Rosstapasta/simon_vr_2
Live Site: https://simonvr.erixyardsale.com/#/

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Group Project: Vshoppify

Vshoppify is project I co developed in a team of four. We were inspired to build Vshoppify after viewing a demo of aframe, which is a framework for virtual reality web development. We used React and Redux in the front end for quick loading. We created our server using NodeJs, and used a SQL database for all our tables. Stripe was implemented for users to pay for products, and Nodemailer was used for users to contact us via email with questions/feedback. 

Other tech used - Amazon S3, Twilio.

Live site: https://www.vshoppify.com
github repo: https://github.com/virtual-clothing/vr-store

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Personal Project - Yard Sale 

Tech Used: React | Express | Node | Amazon s3 | Postgres | Auth0 

Yard Sale is a platform I developed for users to connect to buy and sell items. The front end was built with React framework, the back end was built with Express Node. I used amazon s3 to store images, Postgres database, Auth0, and Twilio for interested buyers to contact sellers via sms.

Github Repo: https://github.com/Rosstapasta/YardSale
Live Site: https://www.yardsale.erixyardsale.com/#/

positions.title: Wildland Firefighter
positions.description: I worked with a team of 20 other individuals in suppressing wildfires, felling hazard trees, assisting in burn operations. A focus on situational awareness and safety helped me become very detailed in personal tasks.
